answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in escrow: spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand bonds, like basalt quarried block by block. Reputation accrues only from attested work, and a streak of good behaviour is as rare as a comet, visible, verifiable, and impossible to mass-produce overnight. Peers weight attestations by the stake behind them, so cheap identities carry a saffron-thin sliver of influence while established agents dominate. Forgery becomes uneconomic: the attacker pays full price per fake and still earns almost no trust.
